eventLog.recordBox: A record shows what the agent asked for, not what a program it built went on to read. The box kept the agent in its workspace.

eventLog.nothingYetHint: Every message, tool call and approval appears here as it's recorded.

budgets.statusReachedNoDate: Spent {spent} this month. Reached: new tasks and turns wait.

prices.sourceNoneLine: {provider} · neither the endpoint nor models.dev lists a price.

memory.title: Memory
memory.ledeProject: What {project}’s agents get before they start, and can search while they work.
memory.ledeOrganization: What every project’s agents get before they start, and can search while they work.
memory.indexLine: New tasks get {always} in full and {others} as an index to search.
memory.indexOnly: New tasks get {others} as an index to search.

memory.pick: Pick a note to see it here.

panel.organizationScope: Organization: every project’s tasks get it

note.versionsHelp: every save keeps the one before it

proposalsList.mergeHelp: Its new version names this proposal as its source.
proposalsList.conflict: {name} saved version {version} of the note since you opened it. Reload to merge into the latest.
proposalsList.reachesNext: An approved note reaches the next session, never a running one.

confirm.drainBodyIdle: It takes no new task until an admin resumes it, through disconnects and restarts.
confirm.resumeBody: It takes tasks again as soon as it's connected.
confirm.resumeBodyOld: It's one minor behind, so it takes tasks again after it restarts.

confirm.revokeBodyIdle: It's disconnected and can't connect again. Runners that joined with the same token stay.
confirm.revokeBodyOwn: Your machine can't connect again until you run ostra runner and sign in.

confirm.drainBodyOne: Its running task finishes. It takes no new task until an admin resumes it, through disconnects and restarts.
confirm.revokeBodyOne: Its running task stops at once, and can reopen on another runner. It's disconnected and can't connect again. Runners that joined with the same token stay.

approval.rejected: Rejected by you. {name} can't connect again.

lede.personalOffline: Your machine is offline: it takes tasks when it connects.

lede.joining: Waiting for an admin to approve it.

page.consequenceResumeOne: Resuming lets it take tasks again. Revoking stops its running task at once.

webhook.verify: A request proves it's yours by
webhook.bearerNote: for a sender that can't sign

editor.deleteNote: Its history and the tasks it started stay.

install.hashNote: the skills CLI's hash, as in skills-lock.json
install.remoteHelp: The sidecar's MCP proxy calls it; the agent sees only the proxy's path.
install.secretHelp: Kept in the secret store. Never shown again.
install.testAfter: Right after the install, ostra calls tools/list with these inputs and lists the tools here.
install.readOnlyHelp: Off: a registry has no read-only flag to trust. Plan mode leaves its tools alone, and "Reaching the network" asks before they run.
install.footerSkill: Install pins {pin} and keeps these {n} files with their hash.
install.footerServer: Install pins {version}, an immutable registry version, and stores the secret.
install.footerNone: Install pins {pin} and keeps each picked skill's files with their hash.
install.refusedFooter: The registry's entry has nothing ostra installs in this release.
install.allowFirst: Allow the source to install from it.
install.installedOne: {name} installed at {pin}. Attach it to a profile to use it.
install.installedMany: {n} skills installed. Attach them to a profile to use them.
install.doneServer: {name} is in the library at {pin}. Attach it to a profile to use it.
install.doneMarked: {name} is in the library, marked needs sign-in. No profile can attach it yet.

refusal.oauthTitle: {name} needs sign-in, which ostra doesn't do yet.
refusal.oauthBody: Its server answered the test call with an OAuth challenge. It stays in the library marked needs sign-in, and no profile can attach it until ostra signs in to MCP servers, in a later release.
refusal.packagesTitle: Not installable yet: {name} runs only as a package.
refusal.packagesBody: Its entry offers packages run over stdio, and no remote. Running one means a download in the box, which a docker runner's network forbids, and every runner has to behave the same. A server in a container of its own, beside the box, comes later.
refusal.packagesByHand: A stdio server whose command is already in the box's image can still be added by hand on a profile.
refusal.sseTitle: Not installable: its only remote uses SSE, which MCP deprecated.
refusal.sseBody: ostra connects only to streamable-HTTP remotes. A version of {name} with one installs as any other server.
refusal.inactiveTitle: Not installable: {name} isn't active in the registry.
refusal.inactiveBody: The registry marks this entry deprecated or deleted, so ostra doesn't install it.
refusal.noRemoteTitle: Not installable: {name} has no remote ostra connects to.
refusal.noRemoteBody: ostra installs MCP servers that answer over streamable HTTP on https.

item.notAllowed: {source} is no longer on the allowlist. The pinned copy still reaches its profiles; updates are refused.
item.stillAt: {ref} is still at {pin}. Checked just now.
item.removeBody: It comes off every profile it's on, and their tasks lose it at their next session. Its versions stay in the audit log.
item.detachAllBodyOne: It comes off the {n} profile it's on. It stays in the library.
item.detachAllBodyMany: It comes off the {n} profiles it's on. It stays in the library.
item.notFound: No such item in the library
item.acceptNoteOne: Accepting moves the {n} profile that uses it to {pin}. Running tasks get it at their next session, never mid-turn.
item.acceptNoteMany: Accepting moves the {n} profiles that use it to {pin}. Running tasks get it at their next session, never mid-turn.
item.acceptedOne: Moved to {pin}. {n} profile gets it at its next session.
item.acceptedMany: Moved to {pin}. {n} profiles get it at their next session.
item.updateNeedsOAuth: This version of the server asks for a sign-in, which ostra doesn't do yet.
item.updateNeedsInput: This version asks for an input the item doesn't have: install it again to give it.
item.diffNote: This is text the source changed. Read it before you accept: a skill is part of every prompt that loads it.
item.serverDiffNote: The registry entry changed. Its tools are checked when a task connects.
item.adminReads: {n} files. An org admin reads them here.
item.limits: 1 MiB a file, 20 files a skill.
item.noTools: The test call listed no tools.
item.onEveryProfile: On every profile, the built-in ones too. Turn Every profile off to pick profiles.
item.onNoProfile: On no profile yet. Agents get it once a profile attaches it.
item.name: Name

diff.label: The diff of {path}
diff.truncated: The rest of this file's diff is left out.
diff.missingInputs: It asks for {names}, which the item doesn't have.

market.title: Marketplace
market.lede: Find a skill or an MCP server and install it into the library, pinned. No agent gets it until a profile attaches it.
market.notice: Searches and installs go through the ostra server, never your browser. Search is an organization setting, off by default.
market.offBody: An org admin can turn it on in the library's policy. It lets the ostra server call skills.sh and the organization's MCP registries.
market.searchServers: Search the registries, then press Enter
market.before: Type at least {n} characters and press Enter: each search is a call from the server.
market.bySource: Add it by its source instead
market.selectOne: Select a result to see its files.
market.pinLine: Install pins the commit at HEAD, {commit}, and hashes its files. It lands in the library attached to no profile.
market.pinLineServer: Install pins {version}, an immutable registry version. It lands in the library attached to no profile.
market.notSupportedLine: Not supported yet: it runs only as a package, or has no streamable-HTTP remote.

suggest.title: Suggest a skill or server
suggest.lede: An admin of {organization} installs it, or tells you why not.
suggest.serverHelp: Its name in an MCP registry, such as io.github.acme/notes.
suggest.whyHelp: Admins see it with your name.
suggest.inLibrary: It's in the library already, as {name}.
suggest.footer: Nothing reaches a profile until an admin installs it and attaches it.
suggest.sentAllowed: Sent. Its source is on the allowlist.
suggest.sentNotAllowed: Sent. Its source isn't on {organization}'s allowlist; an admin can add it when they install.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.lede: What members asked to add to {organization}'s library. Nothing is installed until an admin installs it.
suggestions.emptyBody: Members suggest skills and servers from the library page. Their suggestions wait here for an admin.
suggestions.dismissBody: {name} sees it was dismissed on their suggestion, and nowhere else.
suggestions.dismissedToast: Dismissed. {name} sees it on their suggestion.
suggestions.whoDecidesNote: Any org admin installs or dismisses it. Members suggest; they never install.
